scope: Proposition 5.2 of the manuscript “Compatibility entropy and the spectrum of a Thorp sweep” (preprints/Compatibility-entropy-and-the-spectrum-of-a-Thorp-sweep-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dae8f5ca5b99fbec), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the balanced grid above, let A, D be nonzero orthogonal projections in the group algebras of H, K, respectively, each a tensor product over its individual lines. Let q, s be their ranks in the regular representations of H, K. For all sufficiently large n, in the regular representation of Sn, ∥AD∥4 4 ≤ (qs)1+C/ log n exp(O(n.57 )). (25)
